value.rationale: The affine-invariant isotropic constant is a central volumetric-geometric quantity, and the complete split-graph family connects the canonical cube and simplex by natural edge-completion inclusions. The theorem exactly determines the invariant, proves a strict all-dimensional monotonicity classification along this inclusion chain, and gives a uniform continuum limit separating every macroscopic clique-density regime. The exact determinant-one covariance shear reveals structure beyond volume computation, and the strict graph-edge ordering is not a textbook consequence of inclusion or the classical endpoint values.
